snippet.title: Doll Princess in the Kingdom of Toys
snippet.description:
https://apps.microsoft.com/search/publisher?name=Juan+Jose+Clotet

Doll Princess in the Kingdom of Toys

Embark on a magical platforming adventure in a kingdom made entirely of toys!

Doll Princess in the Kingdom of Toys is a colorful 2D side-scrolling platformer where a brave princess doll explores a whimsical toy kingdom filled with different characters, challenging obstacles, hidden areas, and exciting surprises.

Jump, explore, and battle your way through 25 unique levels in a charming world designed for fun and adventure. Use your special shield, attached to a ribbon, as a weapon: throw it to hit enemies, then retrieve it to continue your journey!

FEATURES

25 exciting levels: Explore a toy kingdom packed with platforming challenges and colorful environments.

Single-player and local multiplayer: Play alone or share the adventure with a friend in two-player mode on the same screen.

Unique shield-throwing action: Throw your shield at enemies and recover it to keep fighting.

Bonus levels and secret areas: Discover hidden passages, explore unexpected places, and uncover extra challenges.

Colorful toy-inspired world: Enjoy high-resolution graphics and a charming setting filled with toy-themed characters.

Immersive background music: Enjoy atmospheric music throughout your adventure.

Game controller support: Play with a compatible joystick or gamepad for a comfortable platforming experience.

Whether you enjoy classic 2D platform games, colorful fantasy adventures, or local multiplayer games to play with friends and family, Doll Princess in the Kingdom of Toys offers a delightful journey full of exploration, action, and surprises.

Enter the Kingdom of Toys and help the Doll Princess conquer all 25 levels!
